column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"That sounds pretty awesome, I hope we're attending!\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “听起来真棒，希望我们会去参加！”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Would you care to dance with me, Fortaime?\"
{image=icons/651.png} \"You're right. Let me think about it.\"
{image=icons/651.png} \"Are you all prepared for the ceremony?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你们都准备好参加仪式了吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"What can you tell me about Peregrino?\"
{image=icons/651.png} \"What can you tell me about Sauleberg?\"
{image=icons/651.png} \"We might have to leave someday, you know.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你知道，我们总有一天可能得离开。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"He needs to calm down a little, yeah.\"
{image=icons/651.png} \"You take things a bit too seriously, Valessa.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “瓦莱莎，你把事情看得太重了。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"As long as we all get along in the end, it doesn't matter.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “只要最后大家能和睦相处，就无所谓。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Why are we only doing this now?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “为什么我们现在才做这件事？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"What's the whole purpose of this ceremony?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “这个仪式的目的到底是什么？”

column3: {image=icons/583.png} \"So what if there's something between us?\"
column4: {image=icons/583.png} “就算我们之间有点什么又怎样？”

column3: {image=icons/580.png} \"I don't comment on rumors and speculation.\"
column4: {image=icons/580.png} “我不对流言和猜测发表评论。”

column3: {image=icons/656.png} \"Hey, don't be so harsh on the guy!\"
{image=icons/583.png} \"Actually, I kind of have a thing for him.\"

column4: {image=icons/651.png} “是啊。非常糟糕的一个，瓦莱莎。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"No. We need to get to Mylus, and fast.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “不。我们得赶到迈勒斯那里，而且要快。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} [[Put your mouth under the tap and drink.]
{image=icons/651.png} [[Go thirsty for an indeterminate amount of time.]
{image=icons/579.png} \"You were a murderer. Plain and simple.\"
{image=icons/660.png} \"I saw a man going about the right thing, the wrong way.\"
column4: {image=icons/660.png} “我看到一个人用错误的方式做着正确的事。”

column3: {image=icons/583.png} \"I actually couldn't get over how attractive you are.\"
column4: {image=icons/583.png} “我实在没法不在意你有多迷人。”

column3: {image=icons/580.png} \"That was a fake vision, so it doesn't really matter.\"
column4: {image=icons/580.png} “那是个假的幻象，所以其实无所谓。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Why couldn't you travel much when you were younger?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你年轻时为什么不能多去旅行？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Stamps are pretty cool. I collect some of them, too.\"
{image=icons/660.png} \"That sounds great. I'd love to write each other.\"
column4: {image=icons/660.png} “听起来不错。我很愿意互相通信。”

column3: {image=icons/583.png} \"You can have as much of my time as you want, Sovy.\"
column4: {image=icons/583.png} “索维，你想要我多少时间都行。”

column3: {image=icons/579.png} \"I'm not so sure that's a good idea. Sorry.\"
column4: {image=icons/579.png} “我不太确定那是个好主意。抱歉。”

column3: {image=icons/580.png} \"Let's play it by ear. We might not survive this.\"
column4: {image=icons/580.png} “走一步看一步吧。我们可能撑不过这一关。”

column3: {image=icons/653.png} \"I'd rather not talk about it, actually.\"
{image=icons/579.png} \"I don't know what to think. I feel lost.\"
column4: {image=icons/579.png} “我不知道该怎么想。我感到迷茫。”

column3: {image=icons/660.png} \"I feel invigorated, like I finally have a purpose.\"
column4: {image=icons/660.png} “我感到充满活力，好像终于有了目标。”

column3: {image=icons/580.png} \"I'm just taking things as they come, to be honest.\"
{image=icons/579.png} \"A dream that no one else will lose their home.\"
column4: {image=icons/579.png} “一个梦想，让其他人不再失去家园。”

column3: {image=icons/660.png} \"The drive to protect my friends from danger.\"
{image=icons/656.png} \"Actually, I have no purpose. I was forced into this.\"
column4: {image=icons/656.png} “其实，我没有什么目标。我是被迫卷入的。”

column3: {image=icons/580.png} \"I'd rather not talk about this, Fortaime.\"
{image=icons/579.png} \"I have no idea what will happen to us, though.\"
{image=icons/653.png} \"You're asking me to make a promise I can't keep!\"
column4: {image=icons/653.png} “你是在让我许下一个无法兑现的承诺！”

column3: {image=icons/656.png} \"Yeah, of course. It'll be a piece of cake.\"
{image=icons/660.png} \"I like the sound of that, actually.\"

column4: {image=icons/651.png} “那把剑刃。它让我看到了幻象。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} [[Prepare the blade for left handed access.]
{image=icons/651.png} [[Prepare the blade for right handed access.]
{image=icons/660.png} \"Yeah, it was a piece of cake.\"
{image=icons/579.png} \"It still hurt me. I need to take it easy.\"
column4: {image=icons/579.png} “那还是伤到我了。我需要悠着点。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"What do you think about all of this?\"

column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你准备好离开瓦利诺斯了吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Anything we should do before we go?\"
{image=icons/651.png} \"Don't other nations handle fine without spirits?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “其他国家没有精灵不也过得好好的吗？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"No need to act cool with me. You can be open.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “不用在我面前装酷。你可以敞开心扉。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I'm sure we'll be fine as long as we stick together.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我相信只要我们团结一致就不会有事。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I wish we could've resolved this peacefully.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我希望我们能和平解决这件事。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"We have to fight back. Negotiations are off the table.\"
{image=icons/651.png} \"Do you think it will really be that scary?\"
{image=icons/651.png} \"I'm sure they had secret motives with Mazeo, too.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我相信他们对马泽奥也另有图谋。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"We might have to cross some lines as well, Fortaime.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “福泰姆，我们可能也得越界了。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"They should be careful not to make {i}us{/i} mad.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “他们最好小心点，别把{i}我们{/i}惹火了。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Yeah, you're right. We'll have to behave.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “是啊，你说得对。我们得规矩点。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I'll do what needs to be done.\"
{image=icons/651.png} \"Alright, we won't leave until you're ready.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “好吧，你准备好之前我们不走。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"What do you think about this blade?\"
{image=icons/651.png} \"I think they wanted their sword back.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我想他们是想拿回自己的剑。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"What are your thoughts on The Triumvirate?\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你对三人执政团有什么看法？”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"You're right. I'm sure there's more to it.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “你说得对。我相信事情没那么简单。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Maybe the blade is just that important.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “也许这把剑刃就是那么重要。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Yeah, we'll unite and take them down.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “是啊，我们会团结起来打败他们。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I'm no fighter. There has to be another way.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “我不是战士。一定有别的办法。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"You can talk to me if you want, Valessa.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “瓦莱莎，如果你想，可以跟我说。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"I feel the same way, to be honest.\"
{image=icons/651.png} \"I'm actually eager to see the world.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “其实我很期待去看看这个世界。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"It's more than a blade. It just looks like one.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “它不只是剑刃。它只是看起来像而已。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"Their lackey took down our entire village with it.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “他们的走狗用它毁了我们整个村庄。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"It steals life to grow their army, Valessa.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “它窃取生命来壮大他们的军队，瓦莱莎。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"If we want to win, we might have to.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “如果我们想赢，可能就得这么做。”

column3: {image=icons/651.png} \"No, I'd never use it like they did.\"
column4: {image=icons/651.png} “不，我绝不会像他们那样用它。”
